mechanism: Efavirenz induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing fluphenazine metabolism and increasing CNS effects; efavirenz also has inherent neuropsychiatric toxicity that compounds antipsychotic side effects.
action: Monitor closely for increased extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, and neuropsychiatric effects; consider alternative antiretroviral or antipsychotic; if continued, may require fluphenazine dose adjustment.
